facts.fact: Minister Yves Iradukunda told the Korea Herald a chatbot helping medical professionals assess whether patients need further attention is being rolled out and the health ministry is testing maternal care tools, including one assessing fetal development.

facts.fact: Minister Iradukunda says Rwanda has established an AI agency to implement its national AI policy.
The government-owned Rwanda AI agency, set up to implement the national AI policy, is being brought into operation through 2026 and will coordinate work previously spread across several institutions.
The AI agency's technical unit, the AI Factory, will build and test applications with private-sector partners, and the agency will help companies access data and computing resources.
